quest.name: An Outlaw's Contract
quest.description: Vex has offered a contract on an outlaw.

talk.text: Take down one outlaw with karma 4 or 5, then tell me about the {contract}. The reward is 500 caps.

stage.journal: Defeat an outlaw with karma 4 or 5, then report to Vex.

ending.journal: Vex settled the contract and paid you 500 caps.

reply.text: We are settled. Browse my {trade} stock.
